description: We are a team of students mostly from Electrotimiș high school
summary: We used Claude ai to make an app that identifies certain locations on earth and analogs them with locations on the moon and mars. It has certain settings for filtering our needs for the locations and gives us a graph backed by liked sources
details:
We identify analogies between locations and bases on Earth
and similar ones on the Moon and Mars.

Creating research and training environments on Earth that
replicate conditions on the Moon and Mars, for the purpose
of preparing astronauts, testing robots, and developing
technologies required for future space missions.

Analog data regarding: geology, planetary science,
engineering, robotics, communications, life support
systems, and local resources.
